authority_note: these probes document how the SDK keeps/drops VISIBLE (non-encrypted) reasoning states and the resulting final tool/text outcome; they are NOT encrypted-ownership passes, the full-cipher gate stays required on the encrypted case, and visible states grant no opaque authority

input_items.note: agent instruction prompt; content not retained
typeless message items (no 'type' key) carry role + content on the Responses wire

max_output_tokens.note: configured limit.output 32768 emits 32000 (same runtime cap as the Chat capture)

reasoning.note: PROVEN DIFFERENCE: nested reasoning object with effort xhigh, not a top-level reasoning_effort string as in the Chat wire

model.note: synthetic task-configured model id bound to the loopback fake provider

response_turn_1_note: each scenario: the fake issues a reasoning output item with summary deltas plus a function_call, then the client sends the turn-2 continuation and a correlated tool result drives the final marker text

absent.issued_note: the fake issues NO reasoning item (encrypted_content absent from the issued output)

sdk_replay_behavior.note: SDK DROPPED the missing reasoning state: turn-2 input has 4 items with no reasoning item; matches_issued is false because there is nothing issued to replay

verification_gate.correlation: issued call_id matched the single function_call_output (correlated_outputs=1, fc_outputs_total=1)
verification_gate.exact_result_roundtrip: final client text equals the 38-byte unpredictable marker exactly (no whitespace normalization)

null.issued_note: the fake issues a reasoning item whose encrypted_content is JSON null (visible, not encrypted)

sdk_replay_behavior.note: SDK DROPPED the null reasoning state: turn-2 input has the same 4-item shape with no reasoning item

verification_gate.correlation: issued call_id matched the single function_call_output (correlated_outputs=1, fc_outputs_total=1)
verification_gate.exact_result_roundtrip: final client text equals the 38-byte unpredictable marker exactly (no whitespace normalization)

empty.issued_note: the fake issues a reasoning item with encrypted_content set to the empty string (visible, not encrypted)

appended_items.derived_note: e3b0c442 / 0 bytes are DERIVED from the observed empty-string state (sha256 of the empty string), not observed item fields
appended_items.note: SDK KEPT the empty-string reasoning item verbatim in the continuation input; id/status absent

sdk_replay_behavior.note: SDK KEPT the empty-string reasoning state (5-item turn-2 input); matches_issued true against the issued empty string

verification_gate.correlation: issued call_id matched the single function_call_output (correlated_outputs=1, fc_outputs_total=1)
verification_gate.exact_result_roundtrip: final client text equals the 38-byte unpredictable marker exactly (no whitespace normalization)

shared_marker_gate.correlation: issued call_id matched the single function_call_output (correlated_outputs=1, fc_outputs_total=1)
shared_marker_gate.exact_result_roundtrip: final client text equals the 38-byte unpredictable marker exactly (no whitespace normalization)

native_output_wrap.note: the native read tool wraps file content in an envelope (192 B observed for the 38 B marker); the wrapped output is not raw file bytes and is not byte-equal to the marker
